title: A test-support helper has one allowed home: the role guards and check_landed_dirs agree on where it may be written
why: Coordinator 03:39 CST Nov 14 (relayed from the lane of PR #3238, which read the guards; neither the coordinator nor triage read the guard code): `builders-cannot-edit-tests` counts hooks/test_support/ as a test path (a builder may not write it), a test-author may not write a non-test path such as hooks/cost_probe.py, so no one agent can move a helper across that line; a create-here delete-there split was refused by the auto-mode classifier; check_landed_dirs.py then fails a helper in a subfolder of a landed folder (hooks/test_support/cost_probe.py). Fact 03:45 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:40, from the lane of #3238's read of the CI wiring; unchecked by triage): a test_ rename of the helper (hooks/test_cost_probe.py) breaks CI wiring: lint/test_windows_split.py CiCoverage needs a checks.yml run step for every tracked test_*.py, and .github/scripts/touched-tests.py:47 TEST_PATTERNS would run a test_ helper as a script. So the rename is not a way out; the coordinator's route for #3238 is a by-hand file move on the owner's computer (hooks/test_support/cost_probe.py to hooks/cost_probe.py, plus the 12 import edits and 2 doc lines), posted as an owner task. This step may make that move unnecessary if it lets a helper live in the test folder. Triage read of the 12 files on lane/watcher-cost-main e202cfedb840: each has one sys.path.insert of the test_support folder and one comment naming it. Owner task posted 03:57 CST Nov 14: item 829 (act-move-cost-probe): option a, the owner runs one move command (proved by triage on a throwaway copy of lane/watcher-cost-main e202cfedb840: all 12 cost test files pass moved and unmoved; the command needed a second edit, cost_probe.py's repo-root path, found by the test); option b, wait for this step's lane. If this step lets a helper live in the test folder, option b makes the move unnecessary.
source: Neighbours: builder-probe-false-alarm and test-author-ci-step-false-alarm (false alarms of the same role-scope guard), builder-bash-test-write, mixed-merge-resolver (a role that spans test and product files), refusal-names-way-out (each refusal names an allowed way out: here none exists for a helper). Decision builders-cannot-edit-tests (read by name only). Coordinator pick for #3238 only: rename the helper to hooks/test_cost_probe.py (a test path, the test-author does it), after the lane reads how test_*.py files are collected; fall back to the owner's computer if that breaks something. Option c of the lane (a known exception in the shared check) widens a shared tool, and is not taken.
note: Triage 03:40 CST Nov 14: done check: a doc line and a test say where a new test-support helper may live (a name or folder the role guards call a test path AND check_landed_dirs accepts), so one role can create it with no second role; red first: a helper at that home fails today (or is unwritable) and passes after. The lane first reads builders-cannot-edit-tests, the guard's path list and check_landed_dirs.py, and says whether the answer is a rename convention (test_*.py) or a rule change. A guard or check verdict may move: round 3 rule applies. Own lane; tracker: the coordinator. Not started. No owner question yet; a pick that widens a shared tool would go to the owner as a widening option. Lane started 03:40 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 03:40, relayed): Sonnet medium, tracker the coordinator, path ALONE, draft PR; guard or check change, so round 3 and the net-value test apply. Grant line: standing rule parallelism-keep-going.
